title: Convex-Analytic View of Query Selection for Safety Verification of Markov Decision Processes
abstract: arXiv:2610.17541v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety verification of a Markov decision process (MDP) asks whether the probabilities of reaching several failure states jointly lie in a convex safe region under every scheduler. Watanabe and Unno (2026) prove safety by refining an outer approximation of the failure probabilities, where each query bounds a nonnegative weighted sum of the probabilities. Their rule selects weights by the largest Euclidean violation. We present a unified framework to measure violation in an explicitly chosen error unit: directions are scored by the support-function gap between the outer approximation and the safe region, normalized by the support function of the unit. We show that the maximal score, when positive, equals the smallest enlargement of the safe region in multiples of that unit that contains the outer approximation. translated_title: 马尔可夫决策过程安全验证中查询选择的凸分析视角
translated_abstract: 马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的安全性验证旨在回答：在每一个调度器下，到达若干失效状态的概率是否共同位于一个凸安全区域内。Watanabe 和 Unno（2026）通过不断细化失效概率的外近似来证明安全性，其中每个查询都给出这些概率的某个非负加权和的上界，而他们的规则以最大欧氏违反来选择权重。我们提出了一个统一的框架，在显式选定的误差单位下度量违反：对每个方向，以外近似与安全区域之间的支撑函数间隙进行打分，并用该单位的支撑函数进行归一化。我们证明，当最大得分为正时，该得分恰好等于使外近似被包含在安全区域内所需的最小扩张倍数（以该误差单位计）。欧氏单位可以恢复先前的规则；而以单位立方体和安全区域本身作为误差单位，则产生了两种新规则。我们进行了实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出一个基于支撑函数的统一凸分析框架，用可选的误差单位归一化度量查询方向的违反程度，并证明最大得分等于包含外近似所需的安全区域最小扩张倍数，由此恢复已有欧氏规则并生成两种新的查询选择规则。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified convex-analytic framework that scores query directions by support-function gaps normalized in an explicitly chosen error unit, proves the maximal score equals the minimal enlargement of the safe region containing the outer approximation, recovers the prior Euclidean rule, and generates two new rules from the unit cube and the safe region itself.
